What we make

Generative tools. A filmmaker's eye.

SynKyn sits between the edit suite and the model. We direct AI image and video systems the way a cinematographer directs light — with intent, references, and a grade in mind from frame one.

Why AI-native

Production economics, rewritten.

Generative pipelines don't replace craft — they relocate it. The taste, the references, the grade, the restraint: that's still human. What changes is what a small team can deliver, and how fast.

Days, not quarters

Concept-to-delivery timelines collapse. A campaign's worth of film can be looked, generated, and graded inside a single sprint.

Impossible shots, shot anyway

Period streets, destroyed cities, products in places no crane reaches — built with historical accuracy and physical plausibility.

One look, every format

A single visual language deployed across film, social cutdowns, key art, and OOH — consistent down to the grain structure.

Iterate like editors

Change only what the note asks for. Structure-preserving revisions mean version 14 still matches version 3 where it should.
